provenance: New source translation with E3590-E3599 and E3680-E3689 as adjacent context.
context: Riddle feedback; Carmine finds seal research, then meets Lady Marbas and asks about Chu Lu Gah. Marbas tests whether the party will bargain with a monster.
decisions: Carmine's kitten epithet preserved. Branches are translated separately. Sentences spanning rows remain incomplete at corresponding boundaries.

translations.en: Try again.
Food is eaten and swallowed through the mouth.
It isn't swallowed through the ears.
Something like an invisible wall
blocked your path.
This was certainly a library.
Thousands of books packed its shelves.
Examining them alone would take a considerable time.
But books were not the only things in the room:
several boxes stood there as well.
Were valuable books stored inside them?
Those boxes would be the best place to start searching.
Inside one box were what appeared to be @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r notes
from his research into the seal.
There's too much to read here.
Let's take it back and study it.
It happened just then...
A voice like a rumble from beneath the earth rang out,
and a monster attacked.
What on earth is going on?
Were monsters keeping watch over this place?
Something here must be inconvenient for them.
Does that mean these notes really are that important...?
Anyway, let's get back to the tavern.
We should be safe there.
Those things might attack again on the way,
so make absolutely sure you protect me.
An enormous lion was watching something intently!
You tensed for a moment,
but a closer look showed it was a stone lion statue.
The statue's looking to the left.
Come on, let's go!
Suddenly, a shining being that looked like a fairy
hovered before you, smiling pleasantly.
Hello. Humans coming here? The end of the world must be near.
Well, the world really does seem to be ending,
so isn't that fitting?
I heard you were the monster who bargained with @7rChu Lu Gah@0r,
so I expected some enormous demon. What a letdown.
Hmm. You're connected to @7rChu Lu Gah@0r, are you...?
And what do you want with me?
I want to know what kind of person @7rChu Lu Gah@0r was.
And what this failing seal really is, and what lies sleeping
beyond it. Could you tell us?
What an impudent little kitten...
Very well. I'll make an exception and tell you.
As for who @7rChu Lu Gah@0r really was,
a hero who risked his life to save the world...
Wouldn't that description do?
Posterity remembers a mage who cursed this town
in a fit of rage.
Does it? That's a pity.
Until the very end, he regretted having to involve
the townspeople. How times change.
Even I only have a vague idea
of what lies beyond this seal.
Something that must never mingle with this world.
Can't you be a little more specific?
Is that how you ask someone a favor?
Who taught you your manners?
If you want to know, give me money or goods of suitable value.
You're not such naive adventurers that you expect
to learn everything for free, are you?
Well? Will you make a deal?
@7rLady Marbas@0r spoke seductively,
then licked her lips with a sensual, scheming air.
What should you do?
Make a deal
Refuse the deal
Perhaps using a monster's knowledge to defeat the demon god
was a necessary step.
You made up your mind to accept the deal.
Hah, fools! Do you think you can protect the seal
with such thoughtless judgment?!
Radiating a fiendish, terrifying aura,
@7rLady Marbas@0r attacked.
Defeated by mere children...
I must be losing my touch.
Very well. I'll tell you.
If you're this strong, perhaps you really can
